AI Overview
Tap Road Beat is a fast-paced, neon-lit arcade and rhythm game where you guide a rolling ball along a glowing track. 
How to Play
Controls: Tap the screen or click the left mouse button to switch the ball between lanes.
Avoid Obstacles: Dodge sharp barriers, spikes, and gaps along the track.
Match the Beat: In Level Mode, synchronize your lane changes to the rhythm of the electronic or EDM soundtrack.
Collect Rewards: Gather gems and items during your run to unlock new ball skins and track customisations. 
Game Modes
Level Mode: Objective-based stages featuring music-driven pacing and specific goals.
Endless Road Challenge: An infinite track that increases in speed and difficulty the longer you survive. 
You can try the game directly via browser platforms like Tap Road Beat - 1Games or Tap Road Beat.
